name: atom-ai
description: CLI agent bridge for Atom: run opencode, aider or claude-code with editor context

customCommand.title: Custom command
customCommand.description: Used when agent is 'custom', e.g. 'myagent --flag'. The prompt is appended as the last argument.

extraPath.title: Extra PATH
extraPath.description: Directories (colon-separated) prepended to PATH, for agents installed outside the desktop launch environment.
